summary: The recorded source already decouples donated prefill Mamba checkpoint spacing from chunked_prefill_size: checkpoint depths use lcm(mamba_cache_chunk_size, radix tree page). Focused scheduler/cache regressions pass, so no duplicate source fix was made.

tests.what_was_measured: Five deterministic scheduler/grid cases covering donated prefill checkpoint depth, widened and unwidened tree pages, and independent tracking interval boundaries; 5 passed.
Actual Mamba radix-cache LRU match behavior under two branched chains; confirms only the consumed checkpoint is refreshed; 1 passed.
Recorded the single assigned GPU as AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950; this is not the report's NVIDIA sm_120 platform.

gpu_execution.evidence: The issue-specific checks are scheduler/cache control-flow tests and ran on CPU. The assigned single GPU was inventoried as AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, but no relevant full-model GPU execution was possible without the reported Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 weights and NVIDIA sm_120 platform.

remaining_limitations: The assigned AMD gfx950 GPU cannot reproduce the report's NVIDIA sm_120-specific environment.
No full HTTP serving, semantic-accuracy, or production-load reproduction is claimed.
Finite Mamba checkpoint pools can still evict old checkpoints; the verified resolution is specifically removal of chunked_prefill_size as the prefill checkpoint-density control.
